universal.name: Command Re-roll
universal.when: Just after making a D6 roll (Advance, Charge, Desperate Escape, or Hazardous test)
universal.effect: Re-roll that dice. Each dice may only be re-rolled once.

universal.name: Rapid Ingress
universal.effect: One friendly unit currently in Reserves moves onto the battlefield as if it were your Movement phase. It cannot charge this turn.
universal.restriction: Cannot arrive within Engagement Range of any enemy unit

universal.name: Heroic Intervention
universal.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit ends a Charge move
universal.effect: One friendly CHARACTER unit within 3" of that enemy unit can move up to 3", ending closer to or within Engagement Range of an enemy.
universal.restriction: CHARACTER must not already be in Engagement Range of an enemy

universal.name: Grenade
universal.when: Your Shooting phase, before a unit shoots
universal.effect: One model in that unit makes one attack with a Grenade weapon instead of shooting any of its other weapons.
universal.restriction: Model must be equipped with a Grenade weapon. Cannot be used during Overwatch.

universal.name: Overwatch
universal.when: Opponent's Movement or Charge phase, when an enemy unit is selected to move
universal.effect: One friendly unit can shoot at the moving enemy unit. Only unmodified hit rolls of 6 score hits.
universal.restriction: Friendly unit must be visible to and within range of the enemy, and not in Engagement Range of any enemy

universal.name: Go to Ground
universal.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly Infantry unit is selected as a target
universal.effect: Until end of phase, each time an attack targets that unit, add 1 to the armour saving throw.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, worsen the AP of all attacks that target that unit by 1 (e.g. AP-2 becomes AP-1).

stratagems.name: Only in Death Does Duty End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: If that unit is not Battle-shocked, it can fight before being removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Honour the Chapter
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, melee weapons that models in that unit are equipped with gain the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Strategy
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Doctrine (Devastator, Tactical, or Assault). Until the start of your next Command phase, that Doctrine is active for your army in addition to any other active Doctrine.

stratagems.name: Storm of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before a unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, ranged weapons that models in that unit are equipped with gain the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.name: Squad Tactics
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move within 9" of a friendly unit
stratagems.effect: That friendly unit can make a Normal Move of up to D6" (it cannot end this move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit).

stratagems.name: Angelic Grace
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a mortal wound is allocated to a friendly unit
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, after a friendly unit Advances
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, that unit can still shoot or charge. If you choose instead to have that unit succumb to the Red Thirst (it becomes Battle-shocked), until end of turn it can both shoot and charge.

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, after a friendly unit Falls Back
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, that unit can still shoot or charge. If you choose instead to have that unit succumb to the Red Thirst (it becomes Battle-shocked), until end of turn it can both shoot and charge.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, worsen the AP of all attacks that target that unit by 1 (e.g. AP-2 becomes AP-1).

stratagems.name: Savage Echoes
stratagems.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after a friendly unit is charged by an enemy unit
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, add 1 to the Strength OR add 1 to the Attacks of melee weapons in that unit (your choice). If you choose instead to have that unit succumb to the Red Thirst (it becomes Battle-shocked), until end of turn it gains both bonuses.

stratagems.name: Red Rampage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a friendly unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, melee weapons that models in that unit are equipped with gain the [LANCE] OR [LETHAL HITS] ability (your choice). If you choose instead to have that unit succumb to the Red Thirst (it becomes Battle-shocked), until end of phase they gain both abilities.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Precision
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before an Aspect Warriors unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Choose one ability to grant that unit: [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1], or [IGNORES COVER]. If you first remove one Aspect Shrine token from that unit, choose two abilities instead.

stratagems.name: To Their Final Breath
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit has been selected as the target of attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed without having fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, that model can fight before being removed. If you first remove one Aspect Shrine token, add 1 to the result.
stratagems.restriction: Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine units only

stratagems.name: Warrior Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, just before an Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine unit is selected to shoot or fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, ignore all modifiers to that unit's Hit rolls, Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, Strength, AP, and Damage characteristics.
stratagems.restriction: Aspect Warriors or Avatar of Khaine units only

stratagems.name: Strike and Fade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after an Aspect Warriors unit has shot
stratagems.effect: That unit can immediately make a Normal Move of up to 6". It cannot end this move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Aspect Warriors units only. That unit must not have Advanced this turn.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Doom
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an Aspect Warriors unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

stratagems.name: Path of Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Aspect Warriors unit that has at least one Aspect Shrine token. Add 1 Aspect Shrine token to that unit.
stratagems.restriction: Aspect Warriors units only. Cannot take a unit above its maximum token limit.

stratagems.name: Woe Betide the Foe
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, just before a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit is selected to shoot or fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
stratagems.restriction: Dire Avengers or Guardians units only

stratagems.name: Shield of the Craftworld
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time an attack targets that unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the armour saving throw.
stratagems.restriction: Dire Avengers or Guardians units only

stratagems.name: Vengeful Retort
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a friendly Dire Avengers or Guardians unit
stratagems.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, one friendly War Walkers unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but can only target that enemy unit. Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Rapid Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a Storm Guardians unit is selected to move
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, do not roll for that unit's Advance move. Instead, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Webway Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: Remove one Dire Avengers or Guardians unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. At the start of any of your future Movement phases, it can arrive anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from any enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Infantry units only. Cannot be used if the unit is in Engagement Range of any enemy.

stratagems.name: Fortune
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Aeldari Psyker unit within 12" of a Guardians or Dire Avengers unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an attack targets one friendly Guardians or Dire Avengers unit within 9" of that Psyker, the attacker's hit roll cannot be re-rolled.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Eternal Guardian
stratagems.when: Your Command phase. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: Select one NOBLE or OVERLORD unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit cannot be Battle-shocked and friendly units within 6" of it are not affected by Battle-shock.
stratagems.restriction: Noble or Overlord units only. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Hungry Void
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a Necrons unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons that models in that unit are equipped with, and improve the AP of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before a Necrons unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if the target is within half the weapon's range, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Undying Legions
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making its attacks against a Necrons unit
stratagems.effect: If any models in that unit were destroyed by those attacks, initiate Reanimation Protocols for that unit. Roll one D3 extra reanimation dice in addition to the normal amount.
stratagems.restriction: Necrons units with Reanimation Protocols only

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Sudden Storm
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a Necrons unit is selected to move
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, ranged weapons that models in that unit are equipped with gain the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, when that unit Advances this turn, you can re-roll the Advance roll.

stratagems.name: Protocol of the Vengeful Stars
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making its attacks against a Necrons unit
stratagems.effect: If any models in that unit were destroyed by those attacks, that Necrons unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but can only target the attacking enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Necrons units only. Once per phase.

stratagems.name: Rapid Regeneration
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Tyranids unit that has lost one or more wounds. That unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranids units only. Cannot be used on a unit that has already used Rapid Regeneration this battle.

stratagems.name: Death Frenzy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Tyranids unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 4+, that unit can fight before being removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Adrenal Surge
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a Tyranids unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Endless Swarm
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one destroyed Tyranids Infantry unit. A new unit identical to the destroyed unit is added to your Strategic Reserves with D3+3 models, all with their full wounds remaining.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranids Infantry units only. Once per unit per battle.

stratagems.name: Overrun
stratagems.when: Fight phase, after a Tyranids unit has fought
stratagems.effect: That unit can make an additional Consolidation move of up to 3".
stratagems.restriction: Tyranids units only. That unit must have fought in this activation.

stratagems.name: Predatory Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Tyranids unit that is within Synapse range of a friendly Synapse unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit gains one of the following: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (shooting), or +1 Attack (melee), or add 2" to its Move characteristic.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranids units within Synapse range only

stratagems.name: 'Ere We Go
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just before a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to charge
stratagems.effect: Add 2 to that unit's Advance and Charge rolls until end of phase.

stratagems.name: 'Ard as Nails
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, subtract 1 from all Wound rolls made against that unit.
stratagems.restriction: Orks units only (not GRETCHIN, VEHICLE, or MONSTER)

stratagems.name: Mob Rule
stratagems.when: Battle Shock step of your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Orks INFANTRY unit that is not Below Half-strength and has 10 or more models. Until the start of your next Command phase, you can use Stratagems on Battle-shocked friendly Orks INFANTRY units within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a friendly Orks unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Careen!
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Orks VEHICLE unit with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed and rolls a 6 for that ability. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: Before resolving the Deadly Demise ability, that unit can make a Normal Move or Fall Back move of up to its Move characteristic. It can move over enemy units (except MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as though they weren't there.
stratagems.restriction: Orks VEHICLE units with Deadly Demise only

stratagems.name: Orks is Never Beaten
stratagems.when: Opponent's Charge phase, when a friendly Orks unit fails a Battle Shock test
stratagems.effect: That unit does not suffer the effects of Battle-shock until the end of your next turn. In addition, add 1 to that unit's Objective Control characteristic until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Disregard
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, worsen the AP of all attacks that target that unit by 1 (e.g. AP-2 becomes AP-1).

stratagems.name: Millennia of Experience
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement or Charge phase, when an enemy unit is set up or ends a move within 9" of a friendly unit
stratagems.effect: That friendly unit can immediately make a Normal Move of up to 6". It cannot end this move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Bringers of Despair
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a non-DAMNED unit within Engagement Range of your Focus of Hatred is selected to fight. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.restriction: Non-DAMNED units within Engagement Range of your Focus of Hatred only

stratagems.name: Endless Ire
stratagems.when: Any phase, when your current Focus of Hatred unit is destroyed. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly non-DAMNED CHARACTER unit. That enemy unit becomes your new Focus of Hatred until your next Command phase.
stratagems.restriction: Must have a non-DAMNED CHARACTER unit on the battlefield

stratagems.name: Black Crusade
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a non-DAMNED Infantry or Mounted unit is selected to move
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, that unit can shoot after Advancing or Falling Back. In addition, until end of turn, bolt pistols, boltguns, and combi-bolters that models in that unit are equipped with gain the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.restriction: Non-DAMNED Heretic Astartes Infantry or Mounted units only

stratagems.name: Warp Surge
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a friendly unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in that unit. In addition, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.restriction: Heretic Astartes or DAEMON units only

stratagems.name: Plaguesurge
stratagems.when: Your Command phase. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: If your WARLORD is on the battlefield, until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
stratagems.restriction: Warlord must be on the battlefield. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Leechspore Eruption
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Death Guard model that has lost one or more wounds. Select one enemy unit within 3" of that model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds that model has lost. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (max 6) and your model regains 1 lost wound (max 6).

stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (to a minimum of 1).

stratagems.name: Putrid Detonation
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Death Guard VEHICLE or MONSTER unit with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed
stratagems.effect: Do not roll to determine whether Deadly Demise mortal wounds are inflicted — they are automatically inflicted. Any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds from this explosion are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.restriction: Death Guard VEHICLE or MONSTER units with Deadly Demise only

stratagems.name: Overwhelming Generosity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Death Guard CHARACTER unit and one enemy unit visible to it. Until end of phase, each time a Death Guard unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the dice used to determine the number of attacks made by that weapon.

stratagems.name: Creeping Blight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before a Death Guard Infantry unit that has not yet been selected to shoot is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Fields of Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before two Astra Militarum units are selected to shoot the same enemy unit
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, improve the AP of all attacks made by those two units against that enemy unit by 1.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum units only. Both units must target the same enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Inspired Command
stratagems.when: Opponent's Command phase. Epic Deed.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Astra Militarum OFFICER unit on the battlefield. That OFFICER unit can immediately issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum OFFICER units only. Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Stalwart Protector
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Select one Astra Militarum VEHICLE unit within 3" of one of the targeted friendly INFANTRY units. Until end of phase, the targeted INFANTRY units within 3" of that VEHICLE unit count as being in cover.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum VEHICLE and INFANTRY units only

stratagems.name: Reinforcements!
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: A new unit identical to the destroyed unit (at its Starting Strength, with all wounds remaining) is added to your Strategic Reserves and can arrive in subsequent turns.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment units only. Once per unit per battle.

stratagems.name: Suppression Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly Astra Militarum unit has shot and scored at least one hit against an enemy unit
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 1 from the Ballistic Skill of models in that enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Cannot target MONSTER or VEHICLE units

stratagems.name: Expert Bombardiers
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before a friendly unit with [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made with [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons by models in that unit, provided one friendly unit with a vox-caster has line of sight to the target.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum units with [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons only

stratagems.name: Bionic Endurance
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.restriction: SICARIAN, PTERAXII, or SYDONIAN units only

stratagems.name: Binharic Offence
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before two Skitarii units are selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until end of phase, improve the AP of ranged attacks made by those two Skitarii units against that enemy unit by 1. Those units can only target that enemy unit this phase.
stratagems.restriction: Skitarii units only. Both units must target the same enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Expedited Purge Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a Skitarii unit is selected to move
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, that unit can Advance and still declare a Charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Isolate and Destroy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just before a Skitarii unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to Wound rolls made by models in that unit, provided there are no other enemy units within 6" of the target.

stratagems.name: Programmed Withdrawal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: Remove up to two SICARIAN units, or one SKITARII INFANTRY or SKITARII MOUNTED unit, from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. They can arrive in subsequent turns.
stratagems.restriction: SICARIAN, SKITARII INFANTRY, or SKITARII MOUNTED units only. Units cannot be in Engagement Range of any enemy.

stratagems.name: Shroud Protocols
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, enemy units cannot target that unit unless they are within 18" of it. If any enemy unit is already within 18", it can still target normally.
